method: Country FE. Two-step residualization: (1) regress log_GDP on education with country FE to get GDP residuals (GDP not explained by education), (2) use residuals to predict TFR(T+LAG_TFR). Compares education R², raw GDP R², and residualized GDP R². Entry-cohort with ceiling. T=1960-1990, lag=LAG_TFR=5 (parent cohort age 20-24 at T is age 25-29 at T+5, the reproductive peak). Three education levels: primary, lower secondary, upper secondary.
